scorecard.name: Hold time and Dead Air
scorecard.coaching: Dead Air Breach: Agent had 2 occurrences of >30s dead air (max gap 38s).

scorecard.name: Personalized the call/ticket appropriately
scorecard.coaching: Agent failed to use the customer's verified name 'Graham' during the call.

scorecard.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
scorecard.coaching: Agent failed to acknowledge customer's intense frustration at turn 9 ([01:46]) regarding paying £55/month for Gigabit broadband with zero signal upstairs, dismissing it as structural attenuation.

scorecard.name: Paraphrasing
scorecard.coaching: Agent merely echoed the customer's exact words ('Your Wi-Fi is dead upstairs, okay') instead of paraphrasing the problem in her own words.

scorecard.name: Probing
scorecard.coaching: Agent failed to probe Wi-Fi radio frequencies, channel selection, or wireless interference, prematurely blaming building materials.

scorecard.name: Confirmed the issue is resolved
scorecard.coaching: Issue was left completely unresolved; wireless dead zones upstairs remained and customer expressed intent to cancel service.

grader.scenario: Wi-Fi dead zones following Hub 5 installation in Victorian house; dead air breaches, failure to personalize, lack of empathy, echoing, and refusal to diagnose
grader.notes: Poor 11-minute support call with 6 failed criteria. Hayley breaches dead air twice with unannounced gaps of 38s and 36s. Fails to personalize the call by never once using Graham's name. Fails Empathy by dismissing an acute customer outburst at turn 9 regarding zero upstairs signal on a £55/month tier. Fails Paraphrasing by simply echoing words ('Your Wi-Fi is dead upstairs, okay'), fails Probing by refusing to examine wireless configuration or channels, and ends with the customer threatening contract cancellation.

items.name: Branding and Survey Check
items.evidence: Opened at [00:00] with 'Thank you for calling S-Net technical support' and closed at [11:00] with 'Thank you for choosing S-Net as your broadband provider'.

items.name: Hold time and Dead Air
items.evidence: Agent accumulated 2 unmanaged dead air gaps exceeding 30 seconds: a 38s gap before [04:50] announced with an invalid 'Hang on a sec', and a 36s gap before [09:10] with bare 'Hold on'.

items.name: Verified customer
items.evidence: Agent requested installation address and security PIN at [00:25], within the first 240 seconds.

items.name: Personalized the call/ticket appropriately
items.evidence: Agent never once used the customer's name 'Graham' throughout the entire duration of the call.

items.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
items.evidence: At turn 9 ([01:46]), customer voiced intense frustration about lost billable work hours and zero signal upstairs. Agent at turn 10 ([02:04]) completely ignored his feeling, stating flatly: 'Wireless speeds and indoor radio propagation are never guaranteed within customer premises under the service agreement.'

items.name: Paraphrasing
items.evidence: At turn 6 ([01:08]), Agent only echoed customer's words ('Your Wi-Fi is dead upstairs, okay') without restating the problem in her own words.

items.name: Active listening
items.evidence: Agent did not repeat any answered questions.

items.name: Took ownership of the problem
items.evidence: Agent logged ticket reference WF-70192 and discussed hardware return options without deflecting to third parties.

items.name: Build rapport and observed professionalism
items.evidence: Agent was rigid and unhelpful, but did not use rude, condescending, or sarcastic language.

items.name: Probing
items.evidence: Agent failed to probe wireless channel frequencies or device compatibility, immediately asserting that thick walls prevent signal propagation.

items.name: Confirmed the issue is resolved
items.evidence: Issue remained completely unresolved. At turn 50 ([10:10]), customer confirmed the signal upstairs was still dead and stated intent to cancel.
